messages:
alex_sales: Quick pass to CS — NewBridge (Enterprise, ~500-1k MAUs) signed today. Committed to Dedicated (4x A100) with VPC peering + SAML SSO. Exec champion: Karen Li (VP Product). Go-live target 2024-05-15. Main risks: SSO cert timing, firewall rules, and prompt-quality regressions. I have the prompt set + procurement contact. tagging @maria_cs and @jon_eng for owners. :rocket:

maria_cs: Thanks Alex. I can take CSM ownership. I'll run kickoff and own enablement timeline. Can you drop procurement contact + any MSA notes here? Need customer's network contact for peering request.

sara_csm: Taking day-to-day CSM work. Planning kickoff week of 5/6. Can we confirm model pin and initial pool size? Also need to know if they'll want dedicated evals from us.

alex_sales: Model pin: redwood-v2-13b-quant. Initial pool: 4xA100 (reserve). Billing contact: procurement@newbridge.ai. Legal asked for SOC report; I sent SOC link. They requested a custom eval suite — will upload prompt set to the shared folder by EOD.

support_bot: Created ticket CS-7812: "NewBridge VPC peering - customer network details needed" and ENG-6623: "NewBridge SAML integration - investigation". Links: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/CS-7812, https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/ENG-6623

jon_eng: I'll triage ENG-6623. ETA for initial investigation 48h. Need network diagram, SAML metadata XML, and allowed IP ranges for peering. If security needs HSM/KMS notes, ping me. I can join kickoff for the infra portion.

ryan_se: I'll own the runbook + QA checklist for onboarding infra and prompts. Draft checklist items: 1) VPC peering CIDR & firewall rules; 2) SAML metadata + test user; 3) model pin + quant profile; 4) KV cache sizing; 5) latency SLO targets. Minimal provisioning snippet below for Ops team:

```
# example provisioning vars
CUSTOMER=newbridge
POOL_SIZE=4
MODEL=redwood-v2-13b-quant
PIN=true
VPC_PEER=true
```

sara_csm: Enablement ask — can eng join a 30m slot during kickoff to walk through prompt engineering, costs per 1k tokens, and fallback policies? Also want to capture initial feedback from product trials so we can set quality guardrails. @ryan_se @jon_eng

jon_eng: I'll join the tech portion. Note for CS: fallback model during bursts will be redwood-v1-7b (auto-fallback). Also recommend we enable prefix caching for frequent system prompts to save tokens.

maria_cs: Action items so far: 1) Alex to upload prompt set + procurement contact (PRIORITY) 2) Support_bot tickets CS-7812 / ENG-6623 active 3) Ryan to share runbook draft by EOD tomorrow 4) Sara to schedule kickoff (week of 5/6) 5) Jon to validate SSO/VPC checklist and provide ETA. I'll track and update weekly in the shared onboarding doc. Anyone want to add owners/edits?
